nodes.title: Establish Clean Baseline Environment and Dependency Verification
nodes.description: Install node_modules, verify deno, typecheck, lint, and run all 108 existing vitest/node tests and 45 deno tests.

nodes.title: Validate Clean Sequential Migrations Chain
nodes.description: Verify all 38 migrations apply sequentially on clean PostgreSQL without schema drift.

nodes.title: Provider Ingestion, Normalization, and Anomaly Quarantine
nodes.description: Harden multi-provider adapter contracts (FastFlights, Amadeus, SerpApi) and ensure strict validation against zero/negative/DST/impossible flights.

nodes.title: Statistical Cohorting, Historical Baselines, and Deal Score Calculation
nodes.description: Compute robust percentiles (p20, median, p80), dispersion, and deterministic Deal Scores with confidence separation.

nodes.title: True Cost, Route Optimization, Connection Risk, and Buy Decision
nodes.description: Itemize baggage/seat/transit fees into known/estimated/optional, assess self-transfer buffers, and output rule-grounded Buy/Monitor/Wait decisions.

nodes.title: Opportunity Feed and Homepage Architecture
nodes.description: Display ranked, diversified deals with evidence badges, freshness indicators, and responsive layouts.

nodes.title: Deal Detail, True Cost Calculator, Risk Transparency, and AI Grounding
nodes.description: Wire complete transparency into /deal/:id, including interactive cost breakdowns, risk factors, price history windows, and sanitized booking links.

nodes.title: Smart Alerts, Turnstile Abuse Prevention, and Deduped Notifications
nodes.description: Validate alert creation with Turnstile tokens, rate-limit budgets, and 24-hour notification deduplication.

nodes.title: Security, RLS Isolation, and Transactional Account Deletion
nodes.description: Ensure zero secret leaks in client builds, verify user RLS separation, and validate explicit DELETE_MY_ACCOUNT flow.

nodes.title: Full End-to-End Playwright Suite & Browser Verification
nodes.description: Execute all Playwright E2E tests on desktop and mobile viewports across all 9 core user flows.

nodes.title: Adversarial Stress Testing and Contract Saturation Check
nodes.description: Falsify requirements against corrupted payloads, DST boundaries, extreme outliers, concurrency, and scan for dead artifacts or unaddressed TODOs.

nodes.title: Release Candidate Audit and Proof Index Signoff
nodes.description: Verify all 33 frozen acceptance criteria pass with durable evidence, release gates close, and 100-point scorecard reaches maximum defensible score.
